name: Jess (Executive Assistant)
description: Runs Monday to Friday summarising what has landed in email, calendar, Notion and Slack, fielding team questions against a written playbook, and posting notes from client calls. Assumes those tools are connected and that someone has actually written the playbook it answers from.
